pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1
sql_duckdb: SELECT a2024.centre_name AS Centre, a2024.month AS Month, (a2024.average_attendance / NULLIF(NULLIF(a2024.enrolment, 0), 0) * 100) - (a2023."Avg Daily Present" / NULLIF(NULLIF(a2023."Enrolled Kids", 0), 0) * 100) AS Decline_Percentage FROM attendance_2024 AS a2024 JOIN attendance_2023 AS a2023 ON a2024.centre_name = a2023."Centre" AND a2024.month = a2023."Month" ORDER BY Decline_Percentage ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
attempts.response:
SELECT
    a2024.centre_name AS Centre,
    a2024.month AS Month,
    (a2024.average_attendance / NULLIF(a2024.enrolment,0) * 100) - 
    (a2023."Avg Daily Present" / NULLIF(a2023."Enrolled Kids",0) * 100) AS Decline_Percentage
FROM
    attendance_2024 a2024
JOIN
    attendance_2023 a2023
    ON a2024.centre_name = a2023."Centre"
    AND a2024.month = a2023."Month"
ORDER BY
    Decline_Percentage ASC
LIMIT 1;
